rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=six-box manduca_bilateral iter-3 (EXPLORATORY). (a) PRIOR: iter-1 (proj_sr=1.5) hr=0.05982; iter-2 (proj_sr=3.0) hr=0.05978 -> proj_sr FLAT (range bandwidth NOT the binding constraint over 1.5-3.0). (b) FAILURE MODE: the proj-bilateral spatial footprint is sub-pixel. With proj_w=5 and bf_d_w_ratio=1/6, proj spatial sigma = (1/6)*5 = 0.83 px < 1 px, so the kernel averages essentially only the center detector sample. No matter how wide the RANGE kernel (proj_sr) is opened, there are no spatial neighbors being pooled, so soft-tissue noise survives into the FBP and hr is pinned. The range bandwidth can only bite once the spatial reach covers real neighbors. (c) LEVER (one knob): bf_d_w_ratio 1/6(=0.167) -> 0.5, raising proj spatial sigma 0.83px -> 2.5px (a genuine ~5-tap pooling footprint), which finally lets the already-wide range kernel average surviving mid-Q soft-tissue noise -> higher calibrated-SSIM-headroom. This is the paper-locked d/w degree of freedom, the highest-impact lever given the tiny (~7-param) capacity where kernel geometry IS the denoising strength. (d) BUDGET: no capacity/epoch change -> ~387-557s wall as in iter-1/2, well inside the 20-min budget. (e) BASE_ITER=1 (hr-best; iter-2 is tied within noise)., bf_d_w_ratio=0.5
